cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll settle tonight's plans. I once hid an invitation because I felt left out. Why hide mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay with you tonight. I nearly skipped your birthday when you invited Leah. Is this about being alone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide the invitation to make me choose you?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offers a jealousy truth as bait; A3 changes tonight plans for B while probing the motive, and A5 risks a more embarrassing truth.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 fear of being left changes A3 company offer; B4 jealousy redirects A5 from solitude to choosing a person.

relationship.evidence: B2 explains concealment and B4 corrects the proposed motive without merely feeding A a lesson.

heightening.evidence: A5 counted photos makes the bid for disclosure more personally costly after B4 names preference.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes hidden invitation and tonight plans; A3 names Leah and the birthday so A5 photos have an explicit event.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 has a necessary concession, truth and question; A5 keeps only the stronger truth and motive question.
